description: Spot the odd one out — a grid of emojis hides one that is slightly different. Find it fast to climb levels with a shrinking timer.

faqs.a: Find the one emoji that differs from all the others and tap it. Each level adds more tiles and less time.
Later levels use near-identical pairs (😀/😃, 🍎/🍏) and bigger grids with tighter timers.
Wrong taps cost 2 seconds of your remaining time.
faqs.q: Is there a penalty for wrong taps?

howto: Find the emoji that is different from the rest.
Tap it before the timer runs out.
Clear levels to face bigger grids and trickier pairs.
title: Odd One Out Game
